name: zerodha-equity-delivery-sell-100k-after-nse-revision
describes: The same Rs 1,00,000 sell priced after 2026-03-01, when NSE raised the cash market transaction charge from 0.00297% to 0.0030699%. Nothing else moved. This is the first shipped rate change the temporal model has had to carry, and the point of it: the 2025 fixture above still prices at the old rate, because its card still covers its own window.
